item.title: WFPD seeks public's help in identifying copper theft suspect
item.description: The Wichita Falls Police Department is investigating the theft of approximately $20,000 worth of copper from a local property.

item.title: Nikky J. Green Memorial Golf Scramble returns to Wichita Falls
item.description: A local event this weekend is honoring a fallen Oklahoma state trooper, while also giving back to the next generation. The Nikky J. Green Memorial Golf Scramble is returning to Wichita Falls after many years away.

item.title: Red Cross Giving Day equips communities for severe weather
item.description: Red Cross Giving Day is Wednesday, and the North Texas region is encouraging people to donate now to help families impacted by disasters, with donations providing emergency shelter, meals, relief supplies, volunteer training, and pre-positioned resources in local communities.

item.title: Iowa Park man headed to prison for child pornography
item.description: A man has been sentenced to prison after pleading guilty to allegations of possessing child sexual abuse materials.

item.title: Henrietta ISD students prep plant sale to support AG program
item.description: If you're ready to start a garden, the Henrietta ISD Agriculture Department may be able to help you out.

item.title: Former Wichita Co. investigator's trial for child sex crimes delayed
item.description: The pending child sex crimes trial of a former investigator with the Wichita County District Attorney's office has been delayed, according to court documents.

item.title: Address reversal sparks frustration for Duncan residents
item.description: Thousands of Duncan residents are being asked to change their addresses again, less than three years after a city-led update, sparking frustration over costs, confusion, and accountability.

item.title: Driver identified in fatal semi-trailer rollover wreck near Electra
item.description: The Department of Public Safety has identified the driver killed in a wreck on U.S. 287 near Electra Monday afternoon.

item.title: Honoring Vietnam Veterans: Ceremony in Wichita Falls
item.description: All veterans who served on active duty in the U.S. Armed Forces from November 1, 1955, to May 15, 1975, regardless of duty location, will be recognized, along with local heroes.
